stdout:
commands:
  help                      this list
  echo [-n] [-e] ARG...     print arguments (-n: no newline, -e: TEXT escapes)
  pwd | cd [PATH] | ls [PATH] | stat PATH
  cat [FILE...]             print files (no FILE or -: stdin)
  write PATH TEXT...        replace file content with TEXT (creates the file)
  append PATH TEXT...       add TEXT at the end of a file (creates the file)
  mkdir PATH | touch PATH | rm PATH (file or empty directory)
  grep [-v] [-i] [-n] [-c] PATTERN [FILE...]   lines containing PATTERN
                            (fixed string; ^ at start / $ at end anchor it)
  wc [-l] [-w] [-c] [FILE...]   lines, words, bytes
  head [-n N] [FILE...] | tail [-n N] [FILE...]   first / last N lines (10)
  sort [-r] [-n] [-u] [FILE] | uniq [-c] [FILE]
  find [PATH] [-name GLOB] [-type f|d]   paths below PATH (GLOB: * ?)
  env | unset NAME... | NAME=VALUE | true | false
syntax: a | b   a > FILE   a >> FILE   a < FILE   a ; b   a && b   a || b
  'literal'  "with $VAR"  \ before a special character  $VAR ${VAR} $? (exit code)
TEXT escapes: \n newline, \t tab, \\ backslash, \xHH any byte
limits: 128 KiB output per command (pipes, > >>), files up to 1 MiB
